title: Remote Control
physicalReconnectedHint: Keep using the virtual display, or switch back when ready.
agentsBlocked: Agents cannot act until you allow them again.
trackpadHint:
Trackpad · Move with one finger · Tap to click
Two fingers scroll / right-click · Hold to drag
viewOnlyDisabled: View only · Remote input is disabled
controlHint: Click to control · Scroll to navigate · Keyboard for shortcuts
viewOnlyHint: View only · Your computer is not receiving input
unlockPc: Unlock this PC locally to continue
unlockScreen: Screen locked · Use the keyboard to unlock
hostPausedHint: All viewers can watch, but no one can click, type or access the clipboard.
resumeInputHint: Remote input is disabled until you resume.
chooseScreenHint: Choose the screen you want to work on.
fallbackHint: Automatic fallback keeps a virtual screen available when physical displays disconnect. Reconnecting a display offers Switch back; it never switches silently.
fallbackUnsupported: This host does not report headless fallback support. Update the host to configure it.
fallbackProvisioning: A virtual display driver must be installed and provisioned separately by an administrator on the host. This control does not install drivers.
ownerHint: Control owner: {{owner}}. Watching does not claim control. Your first input reserves human control until you explicitly allow agents again.
trackpadDescription: One finger moves the pointer. Tap to click, two-finger tap to right-click, two-finger slide to scroll. Hold one finger, then move to drag. Pinch to zoom; the picture follows the pointer near its edges.
touchscreenDescription: Tap where you want to click. Long-press to right-click. Pinch to zoom, then slide one finger to pan. Physical mouse input stays unchanged in either mode.
hapticsHint: Click feedback happens on this device, without waiting for the host. Vibration depends on the device and system settings.
directVideoHint: Direct video uses encrypted peer-to-peer media. Signalling and input stay on Paseo. If direct video cannot connect, frames automatically use Paseo instead.
paseoConnectionHint: Uses your existing Paseo connection. No separate VNC port or public screen URL.
hostSafetyHint: Unlike View only, this stops remote input for everyone connected to this computer.
windowsExperimental: Windows support is experimental. UAC and secure desktops cannot be controlled.
clipboardDescription: Paste text here to send it to the focused app. Supports Chinese and multiline text. This replaces the host's text clipboard.
resumeClipboard: Resume remote control to use the clipboard.
waitingApproval: Waiting for someone at the host to approve screen sharing and remote interaction.
portalApproval: Approve sharing on the host. Turn on Allow Remote Interaction, and Allow Clipboard Access for copy and paste.
linuxMissingBackend: This Linux host is missing input or capture support. Check the host's screen backend.
macPermissions: Allow Screen Recording and Accessibility for Paseo in System Settings → Privacy & Security, then restart Paseo on the Mac.
pastePanelHint: Paste your text into the clipboard panel.
clipboardUnavailable: This client does not expose its clipboard
fallbackCouldNotVerify: Display fallback could not be verified. Check the host, then retry in settings.
fallbackUnknown: Display detection is unavailable; no devices will be changed.
fallbackReconnect: Physical display reconnected. Switch back when you are ready.
fallbackInactivePhysical: Physical display detected but not active. Enable it in Windows Display settings before switching back.
fallbackPhysical: Using the physical display. Virtual fallback is on standby.
fallbackPhysicalInactive: A physical display is connected but Windows has not activated it. No devices will be changed.
fallbackUnmanaged: An unmanaged display is active. Automatic fallback will not change this setup.
fallbackNotVerified: The virtual display was not verified. Retry by enabling fallback in settings.
fallbackUnlock: Unlock and resume before verifying virtual fallback
fallbackActive: Virtual fallback active. Waiting for a physical display.
fallbackOffKeepVirtual: Automatic fallback is off. The current virtual screen stays active so you do not lose the desktop.
fallbackOff: No physical display detected. Automatic fallback is off.
fallbackNeedsAdmin: No physical display detected. An administrator must provision a signed virtual display driver first.
fallbackUnlockHeadless: No physical display detected. Unlock and resume host control before fallback starts.
fallbackDebounce: No physical display detected. Confirming before starting virtual fallback.
fallbackStarting: Starting the managed 1920 x 1080 virtual display
fallbackVerifyFailed: Virtual display verification failed. Retry in settings after checking the host.
fallbackVerifyPhysical: Verifying the physical display before switching back
videoDisabled: Direct video is disabled in this browser; using Paseo frames.
videoDecodingFailed: Video decoding failed; using Paseo frames.
videoPlaybackUnavailable: Video playback unavailable; using Paseo frames.
directConnectionUnavailable: Direct connection unavailable; using Paseo frames.
directVideoDisconnected: Direct video disconnected; using Paseo frames.
videoDidNotArrive: Direct video did not arrive; using Paseo frames.
videoSessionEnded: Video session ended; using Paseo frames.
h264Unavailable: H.264 decoding is unavailable; using Paseo frames.
iceTimedOut: ICE gathering timed out; using Paseo frames.
videoUnavailable: Direct video unavailable; using Paseo frames.
takeOverFirst: An agent is controlling the computer. Use Take over first.
displayChanged: Display changed; wait for a fresh frame
displaySwitching: Display is switching. Wait for a fresh frame before sending input.
displayDisconnected: Display disconnected. Refresh before choosing another display.
allowAgentsResume: Resume remote control before allowing agents
takeOverBeforeAccess: Take over before changing agent access
nativeNoPhysical: No active physical display. Activate it in Windows Display settings first; the virtual screen was kept.
windowMigrationFailed: Some windows could not move. The virtual display remains active; move them manually before retrying.
driverNeedsAdmin: A signed virtual driver must be provisioned by an administrator first.
displayUnlockBeforeSwitch: Unlock and resume host control before switching displays.
virtualKept: The physical display disappeared or control was paused. Virtual fallback was kept.
